mapper.insert: insert into daily_report_item(report_id, product_id, unit_price, delivery_weight, remaining_weight, sort_order, create_time, update_time) values (#{reportId}, #{productId}, #{unitPrice}, #{deliveryWeight}, #{remainingWeight}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unit_price = VALUES(unit_price), delivery_weight = VALUES(delivery_weight), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update:
update daily_report_item
unit_price = #{unitPrice},
delivery_weight = #{deliveryWeight},
remaining_weight = #{remainingWeight},
sort_order = #{sortOrder},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id}
